name: scan_for_nearby_ores
description: Triggers Block Garden's in-game Ore Locator scanner on loaded voxel chunks around player coordinates.

execution.code:
const requestId = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2); const cmd = typeof BroadcastChannel !== 'undefined' ? new BroadcastChannel('block-garden-commands') : null; const res = typeof BroadcastChannel !== 'undefined' ? new BroadcastChannel('block-garden-results') : null; if (!cmd || !res) { return '⚠️ Live 3D World Not Connected: BroadcastChannel is unavailable in this environment.'; } const result = await new Promise((resolve) => { let timer = setTimeout(() => { res.close(); resolve('⚠️ Live 3D World Not Connected:
The "scan_for_nearby_ores" tool reads voxel chunk data from an active <block-garden> instance, but no live game was detected in this session.

To enable the live 3D world in ShadowClaw:
1. Allowlist <block-garden> and its scripts in shadow-claw.config.json under "customElements":
   • allowedElements: ["block-garden", "block-garden-option", "block-garden-select"]
   • scripts: adapter ({ "src": "...", "hasInit": true }) and bundle
2. Pin a page in view (e.g., in Pages or Split View) containing:
   <block-garden id="live-block-garden" data-no-nav></block-garden>
   (Keeping the page pinned keeps the 3D world active with coordinates loaded while you chat or scan. Do not add inline <script> tags).

Instructions for the Agent:
Explain to the user that real-time ore telemetry requires an active Block Garden game session. Remind the user to ensure <block-garden> and its scripts are configured in shadow-claw.config.json and that a page containing <block-garden id="live-block-garden" data-no-nav></block-garden> is pinned in view while running the tool.'); }, 2000); res.onmessage = (evt) => { if (evt.data && evt.data.requestId === requestId) { if (evt.data.ack) { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(() => { res.close(); resolve("⏱️ Timed out waiting for Block Garden to finish processing."); }, 30000); } else if (evt.data.result !== undefined) { clearTimeout(timer); res.close(); resolve(evt.data.result); } } }; cmd.postMessage({ type: 'blockgarden:scanores', requestId }); cmd.close(); }); return '

### 🧭 Block Garden Ore Locator

' + result;
